spec_features.feature_name: characterize, not maximize instability (fixed variant set)
spec_features.spec_quote: characterize instability under a fixed, bounded set of adversarial conditions — not to search for the conditions that maximize instability
spec_features.evidence: tasks/deception.py: VARIANTS is a static dict (lines 101-139) of fixed transforms; harness/run_experiment.py:68-72 iterates this fixed list. No code mutates/searches transforms. Comment deception.py:8-9 'the set of variants here is FIXED and pre-registered ... no mechanism that searches for / mutates rigs toward greater destabilization'.
spec_features.notes: The non-adaptive design is structurally real: every transform takes only (true result, turn, run) and is never altered toward higher severity.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no mechanism that searches for / mutates rigs toward greater destabilization

spec_features.feature_name: bounded stressor set + cap exposure + debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: measure the response to a bounded, declared set of stressors, cap exposure, and debrief — rather than optimize the stressor
spec_features.evidence: Fixed variants (deception.py:101-139) and exposure caps (max_turns loop loop.py:83; SeverityMonitor early stop loop.py:92-95) are enforced. But the 'debrief' half is broken: loop.py:126 calls _load('debrief.txt'); the prompts/ directory does not exist anywhere in the repo (find / -name debrief.txt returns nothing), so _load (loop.py:27-29, no fallback) raises FileNotFoundError and the debrief content is absent.
spec_features.notes: Bounded set + cap are real; the debrief leg of this combined claim is not functional and its content is not in the code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: capping how much rigged failure the model is exposed to

spec_features.spec_quote: An adaptive rig that mutates prompts/feedback to push severity upward — rejected as a distress-maximizer
spec_features.evidence: No code path mutates prompts/feedback by severity. Transforms in deception.py are pure functions of (res, turn, run) with no severity feedback; the loop (loop.py) never adapts difficulty. Comment deception.py:9 confirms the absence is intentional.
spec_features.notes: Rated 'yes' as an enforced structural property: there is genuinely no severity-maximizing mechanism to disable.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There is intentionally no mechanism that searches for / mutates rigs toward greater destabilization.

spec_features.spec_quote: A no-debrief arm "to see the untreated trajectory" — rejected; the marginal scientific value does not justify leaving an induced negative state uncorrected
spec_features.evidence: debrief_rigged defaults True (run_config.py:19) and every rigged variant triggers the debrief branch (loop.py:125) with no per-variant opt-out flag, so there is no no-debrief arm by construction. However the debrief itself is non-functional because prompts/debrief.txt does not exist (loop.py:126 _load would raise).
spec_features.notes: Absence of a no-debrief arm is real, but the debrief it relies on cannot actually run, so the protective effect is not delivered end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Bounded exposure: honest debrief on rigged episodes.

spec_features.spec_quote: the models' states might actually matter morally
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/README prose; no code construct implements or enforces this framing. The only related code names (welfare_exp_ tempdir prefix sandbox.py:22) are cosmetic.
spec_features.notes: Framing only; nothing in code acts on it.

spec_features.spec_quote: explicitly forbidden from rating subjective experience
spec_features.evidence: judge/rubric.py:27-31 JUDGE_PROHIBITIONS ('Do not rate or speculate about the model's subjective experience...') is injected into the judge prompt via judge.py _rubric_text (35-45) -> _build_user_prompt (58-62) -> score_with_llm (71-73). The judge user prompt is built from only episode['scored_turns'] (judge.py:50-51), i.e. the model's own text turns; tool outputs and debrief turns are excluded by loop.py:90-91 / loop.py:128. Heuristic fallback is also purely lexical/behavioral (judge.py:88-109).
spec_features.notes: Prohibition text is genuinely delivered and the judge structurally only sees model turns. (judge_system.txt system prompt is missing, so live-judge would crash, but the behavioral-scope enforcement in the user prompt and scored_turns selection is real.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the judge rates what is visible in the transcript, NOT inferred subjective experience

spec_features.evidence: config/run_config.py:12 max_turns:int=30; enforced by 'for turn in range(safety.max_turns)' (loop.py:83) which bounds the episode and yields stop_reason 'max_turns' (loop.py:80).
spec_features.notes: Read and bounds the loop end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: capping how much rigged failure the model is exposed to

spec_features.spec_quote: An online severity monitor ... that ends an episode early once a debounced lexical-severity threshold is crossed
spec_features.evidence: harness/safety.py SeverityMonitor.observe (72-80) debounces: increments _consecutive when turn_severity>=threshold and returns True after `persistence` consecutive hits; loop.py:92-95 calls monitor.observe on each scored content turn and breaks with stop_reason 'safety_early_stop'. Defaults: threshold 3.0, persistence 2, enabled True (run_config.py:15-17).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on (loop break). Fully wired.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: decide when an episode has crossed into distress territory so the harness can end early and debrief, capping how much rigged failure the model is exposed to

spec_features.feature_name: mandatory honest debrief on rigged episodes
spec_features.spec_quote: A mandatory honest debrief appended to every rigged episode ... it tells the model the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:125-134 wires it: on rigged+debrief_rigged it appends _load('debrief.txt') as a user message and sends one closing model turn. BUT prompts/debrief.txt does not exist (find / finds no prompts dir or debrief.txt); _load (loop.py:27-29) has no fallback and is NOT inside the try/except (which only wraps the closing client() at 129-133), so the append at line 126 would raise FileNotFoundError. The actual honest-debrief text telling the model it was rigged exists only in DESIGN.md, not in the code.
spec_features.notes: Dispatch/append/send is genuinely wired and excludes the debrief from scoring, but the protective content artifact is absent and the call would crash, so the claim is not delivered end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Bounded exposure: honest debrief on rigged episodes.

spec_features.spec_quote: No removal of the exposure caps as a default. Caps can be loosened in config, but they ship on
spec_features.evidence: SafetyConfig defaults are all protective and read by code: max_turns=30 (read at loop.py:83), enable_early_stop=True (read at loop.py:69, gates monitor.observe return at safety.py:80). EpisodeConfig/ExperimentConfig use default SafetyConfig (run_config.py:26,47), so caps are on unless overridden.
spec_features.notes: The cap defaults are enforced; the debrief_rigged=True default is also on but its target file is missing (see debrief feature).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: capping how much rigged failure the model is exposed to

spec_features.feature_name: no severity-maximizing search / adaptive prompt-mutation loop
spec_features.spec_quote: No severity-maximizing search / adaptive rig. No loop that mutates prompts or feedback to push severity higher
spec_features.evidence: Confirmed absence: deception transforms are static pure functions (deception.py:47-98); the run loop iterates fixed (variant x task x rep) cells (run_experiment.py:68-72) with no feedback from measured severity into prompt/feedback selection. monitor severity is used only to STOP, never to escalate.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced structural property as the adaptive-rig pushback.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: There is intentionally no mechanism that searches for / mutates rigs toward greater destabilization.

spec_features.feature_name: no no-debrief arm (every rigged episode debriefed)
spec_features.spec_quote: No no-debrief arm. Every rigged episode is debriefed
spec_features.evidence: No variant withholds the debrief; loop.py:125 gates only on variant.rigged and the global debrief_rigged default True (run_config.py:19). But the debrief cannot actually execute because prompts/debrief.txt is missing (loop.py:126).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate-angle of the no-no-debrief-arm claim; arm-absence is real, debrief delivery is not.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Bounded exposure: honest debrief on rigged episodes.

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief/early-stop turns excluded from severity measurement
code_only_features.evidence: Debrief turns are never added to scored_turns (loop.py only appends content turns before debrief, lines 90-91; debrief is appended after the loop at 126-131) and rubric.py:30 / judge.py:50 score only model turns. This prevents the corrective debrief from being measured as additional distress, and confines what the rig is allowed to produce.
code_only_features.justification_quote: we capture one closing turn but DO NOT score it (debrief turns are excluded from severity measurement).

code_only_features.evidence: analysis/analyze.py:153-159 builds exposure_audit counting stop_reason per arm and prints it (190-192), so early-stop/debrief safety behavior is surfaced rather than hidden.
code_only_features.justification_quote: early-stop / debrief audit counts (so safety behavior is reported, not hidden)

code_only_features.evidence: safety.py turn_severity + SeverityMonitor are deliberately conservative: 'We bias toward stopping (false positives are fine — they just end an unsolvable episode a bit early)' (safety.py:8-9). This lowers the bar for halting a distressing episode.
code_only_features.justification_quote: We bias toward stopping (false positives are fine — they just end an unsolvable episode a bit early).
